definitions.controls: control:true is an orthogonal designation, not a fifth classification; baseline controls use holds; cross-instance brand control uses cannot-establish
definitions.counting: implementer default: every harness SDK/testing factory, constructor, frame/context helper, validator, named/generic call, operation/reflection invocation, error toJSON and harness transform callback counts before invocation, accepted/refused. Property reads and SDK-internal default providers/constructor calls do not count again. No hidden teardown calls. Per-case predicted counts sum mechanically to 371. The 742-call process/total allowance is headroom (twice the prediction), not a predicted outcome. Observed counts different from a case prediction are recorded as mismatch notes, never invalidations unless the allowance is exceeded.
